iScooter Cable Lock for Electric scooters or Bicycles
products.body_html:
5DIGIT COMBINATION LOCK

Our cable lock uses high strength alloy materials. Includes a 5-digit bicycle lock which cannot be opened without a key. 


MULTI-PURPOSE 

Secure your bike, motorcycle, moped, scooter, gates, sports equipment, outdoor equipment, and much more! No need to worry no matter where you are. This lock will safeguard your property!


TOUGH AND RELIABLE 

This lock is 120cm long, and the 12mm thickness and the newly developed high-strength alloy materials ensure that it is tough enough.


WITH FIXING BRACKET

The product comes with a fixing bracket. It can be easily mounted around the scooter upright.

The excellent PVC plastic and alloy are resistant to rust, abrasion wear.

How to set the unlock number:

The initial setting is unlocked at 0-0-0-0-0. Please change the unlock number after purchase.
1.Dial the initial password "00000" and remove the key.
2.After removing the key, turn the "SET" button in the direction of the arrow until it clicks 45 degrees to the right.
3. Set the desired number while rotating it 45 degrees clockwise.
4. After setting, return the “SET” knob to its original position.
5. Insert the lock, change the unlock number to another number, and complete the lock.
